name: Strategy Factor Momentum (252d)
description: Time-series momentum applied at the strategy-sleeve level (Ehsani & Linnainmaa, 2022). Hold only sub-strategies whose trailing 12-month paper NAV return is positive; allocate freed weight to defensive assets (VUTY, SGLN, AGGU). Economic rationale: factor premia autocorrelate as arbitrage capital moves slowly and crowding builds gradually. Expected Sharpe uplift 0.1–0.3 over static equal-weight blend, with lower drawdown from regime-mismatch period exclusions.
